issue_title: [Bug] save 方法中 os.fdopen 与 fchmod 顺序可能导致权限设置后、写入前文件描述符泄露
fix_summary: Fixed file descriptor leak in TodoStorage.save() when os.fchmod fails. Added os.close(fd) call in the except block to ensure proper resource cleanup.
acceptance_criteria_met: fchmod failure now properly closes fd
temp_path is deleted on fchmod failure
added tests verify exception path resource cleanup
risks_limitations: Minor: os.close() is called in except block even if fd was already closed by fdopen, but this is handled gracefully with contextlib.suppress(OSError)
